### Explaining all properties and how I make my digital garden functional. 

The template is that of Anki and Obsidian. 

1. Status
2. Tags
3. Digital Garden Related Properties

Whatever properties you are filling in make sure to write them down in linked format in the file itself.  

🕸️ This is reference of tags. 
Status - This is reference of stage the idea is in.
⚡ This is in reference to the memory stage this idea is in.

This decision comes from not relying on Anki to shifting to Obsidian as a core method of memorization and practice.
It also brings to light how the meaning of memorization has changed for me over time. It is not just solely bound to an app, be it Anki or Obsidian. 

So you can look into it effectively.
